_about: Per-state EHDI reporting reference for the EHDI diagnostic report form. Starting data from a 50-state + DC census (Project research, 2026-09-26/27). Every entry names its source and last-checked date; audiologists can edit their copy when an entry is stale. confidence: confirmed = route and deadline seen on state sources; partial = route confirmed, deadline or details missing; unverified = route not published.

AK.program: Alaska Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) / Universal Newborn Hearing Screening, Alaska Department of Health
AK.deadline: at least monthly (7 AAC 27.620(b)(1)); no per-evaluation day count
AK.who_reports: A person who provides audiological confirmatory evaluation and diagnostic services for newborns and infants screened under AS 47.20.310

AL.program: Alabama Newborn Hearing Screening Program (Alabama EHDI Program, "Alabama's Listening!"), Alabama Department of Public Health

state_form.name: Diagnostic Hearing Evaluation Form (Alabama Newborn Hearing Program)

AL.deadline: as soon as the initial diagnostic audiological evaluation is completed (no number of days given)
AL.who_reports: Health care providers who perform hearing tests on newborns (the audiology provider completes the form)

AR.program: Arkansas Infant Hearing Program (EHDI), Arkansas Department of Health
AR.route: State online system or paper form

portal.name: ERAVE (Electronic Registry/Registration of Arkansas Vital Events)

state_form.name: Arkansas Infant Hearing Diagnostic Test Battery (posted as 'Diagnostic Evaluation Form')

AR.deadline: within 7 business days of the evaluation (to the Infant Hearing Program and the child's primary care provider)
AR.who_reports: Physicians or other providers administering initial screening or follow-up care (audiologists report diagnostic evaluations)

AZ.program: Arizona Early Hearing Detection and Intervention Program (AZ EHDI), Office of Newborn Screening, Arizona Department of Health Services

state_form.name: Audiology Referral and Tracking Form (Office of Newborn Screening)

send_to.note: Attach the written report (required by rule)
Secure email

AZ.deadline: within one week of the test date (program page); rule R9-13-207(G) says tests performed each week are due by the sixth day of the following week
AZ.who_reports: The health care facility, health care provider, or other person that performs the subsequent (including diagnostic) hearing test; the form is signed by the audiologist

CA.program: California Newborn Hearing Screening Program (NHSP), Department of Health Care Services, with regional Hearing Coordination Centers

state_form.name: Diagnostic Audiologic Evaluation Reporting Form (DRF)
state_form.number: NHSP 300-1, region specific: DHCS 6113 Northern (Rev 05/2023); DHCS 6116 Southern

send_to.note: Northern California Hearing Coordination Center only; Southern regions use a different center
Northern region only; secure email

CA.deadline: within 7 days of the child's diagnostic audiologic evaluation (printed on the form)
CA.who_reports: All providers of audiological follow-up and diagnostic services under the program (HSC 124119(d))

CO.program: Colorado Newborn Hearing Screening Program, Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment (CDPHE)

portal.name: Health Information Data System (HIDS) Newborn Hearing (NBH) application

CO.deadline: no deadline for audiology results; the evaluation should occur within the first three months, and when permanent hearing loss is confirmed the referral to early intervention must happen within 48 hours
CO.who_reports: The audiologist who performs the comprehensive evaluation communicates results to the Department; health professionals providing follow-up services enter results in the Department's data system after signing its confidentiality agreement

CT.program: Connecticut Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) Program, Department of Public Health

state_form.name: Diagnostic Audiology Reporting Form (CT DPH Early Hearing Detection and Intervention)

CT.deadline: within 2 days following the appointment (fax to the EHDI Program)
CT.who_reports: The audiologist (initial diagnostic and any later audiological evaluation, for any child born in the last three years and any child under 5 diagnosed with hearing loss)

DC.program: DC Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (DC EHDI) Program, Perinatal and Infant Health Division, DC Health

DE.program: Delaware Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) / Newborn Hearing Screening Program, Division of Public Health
DE.route_note: No hearing-specific form: hearing loss is reported on the state's general Birth Defects Surveillance Form (not posted online), within 30 days by rule; the screening statute says 10 days

state_form.name: Division of Public Health Birth Defects Surveillance Form (Birth Defects Registry)
state_form.number: not posted; the old link (dhss.delaware.gov/dph/chca/files/bdrreportform.pdf) returns 404

DE.deadline: same day as testing if at all possible; no later than 10 days following the testing date
DE.who_reports: Audiologists (all results of newborn, infant, and child hearing screenings and/or testing)

FL.program: Florida Newborn Hearing Screening Program / Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) Program, Florida Department of Health

portal.name: eReports (Florida Newborn Screening online portal, diagnostic module)

FL.deadline: within two business days of the evaluation, via eReports (program page for audiologists); the statute, s. 383.145(3)(j), F.S., and the 2026 state guidelines set an outer limit of 7 days after receipt of results for any related diagnostic testing
FL.who_reports: Audiologists performing diagnostic hearing testing on children 0-3 years of age; the statute covers results of any related diagnostic testing

GA.program: Georgia Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) Program, Georgia Department of Public Health
GA.route: State online system or paper form

portal.name: SendSS Audiology Portal

state_form.name: Surveillance of Hearing Loss in Infants and Young Children (Georgia EHDI Program)

send_to.note: Paper form is for SendSS downtime or no access

GA.deadline: within 7 days of the evaluation for follow-up screening and diagnostic results on babies who did not pass in both ears (program page); within 7 days of diagnosis for hearing loss first confirmed or suspected permanent in a child up to age 5 (program page and the form, citing O.C.G.A. 31-12-2)
GA.who_reports: Audiologists (all follow-up screening and diagnostic results for babies who did not pass in both ears); cases of hearing loss through age 5 are reported by the audiologist or physician who diagnoses

HI.program: Hawaii Newborn Hearing Screening Program (NHSP), Children with Special Health Needs Branch, Hawaii Department of Health

send_to.note: Program contact; no reporting route published

HI.who_reports: Audiologists and physicians specialized in hearing function who perform diagnostic audiologic evaluations of infants: results for infants who do not pass screening and those diagnosed deaf or hard of hearing up to age 3

IA.program: Iowa Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) Program, Iowa Department of Health and Human Services
IA.route: State online system or paper form

portal.name: Iowa Newborn Screening Information System (INSIS), the 'EHDI database'

state_form.name: Iowa's Early Hearing Detection and Intervention Diagnostic Reporting Form

IA.deadline: within six working days of the assessment (641 IAC 3.8; the program page says six business days; the form says 'within 6 days of the hearing assessment in the EHDI database')
IA.who_reports: Any health care professional conducting newborn hearing screens, rescreens, or diagnostic audiologic assessments, for any child under 3 (physicians, audiologists, AEAs, birthing facilities)

ID.program: Idaho Sound Beginnings (Idaho newborn hearing screening program; Idaho Department of Health and Welfare with Idaho Educational Services for the Deaf and the Blind)

state_form.name: Audiology Results Form (Idaho Sound Beginnings / IESDB), birth to 5 years

ID.deadline: within 5 days of every evaluation (printed on the form)
ID.who_reports: Audiologists: 'Report ALL results to Idaho Sound Beginnings (Birth - 5)', including no-shows

IL.program: Illinois Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) Program, Illinois Department of Public Health

state_form.name: Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI): Audiological Follow-up Report (linked as 'Audiological Evaluation Report')

IL.deadline: within 7 days after the date of service or after an inquiry from the Department (77 Ill. Adm. Code 661.110(b), quoting Section 10 of the EHDI Act)
IL.who_reports: Physicians, APRNs, PAs, otolaryngologists, audiologists, ancillary providers, early intervention and parent-support programs, DHS, and UIC-DSCC: all hearing testing, treatment, and intervention outcomes for children birth through 6 years

IN.program: Indiana Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) Program, Indiana Department of Health

state_form.name: Diagnostic Audiology Evaluation (DAE)

IN.deadline: within five business days following the assessment (410 IAC 3-3-12(i)(4))
IN.who_reports: Diagnostic audiology Level 1 facilities: results for each ear, reported regardless of findings; the form also covers children not screened and any child later diagnosed with permanent hearing loss

KS.program: Kansas SoundBeginnings Newborn Hearing Screening Program (KDHE Early Hearing Detection and Intervention), Kansas Department of Health and Environment
KS.route: State online system or paper form

portal.name: Kansas Newborn Hearing Screening database (audiologists with access enter results and upload the written report)

state_form.name: Audiologic Assessment Report Form (Appendix B of the Kansas Guidelines for Infant Audiologic Assessment); current guidance is to fax the audiologist's own written report

send_to.note: Preferred: fax your own written report

KS.deadline: within 7 days of the evaluation (Kansas Newborn Hearing Screening Guidelines, 2024, citing K.A.R. 28-4-605 to 611); the program page says fax 'as soon as possible'; the older audiology guidelines said within one month for hearing loss and immediately for normal results
KS.who_reports: Audiologists: all follow-ups on newborn screening referrals, including every newly confirmed permanent hearing loss through age eight (program page); by rule, each person who determines that a newborn or infant has hearing loss

KY.program: Kentucky Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) Program, Office for Children with Special Health Care Needs (OCSHCN)
KY.route: State online system or paper form

portal.name: KY-CHILD electronic information system

state_form.name: Audiology Update Form (AUF) Worksheet

send_to.note: Encrypted email

KY.deadline: within forty-eight (48) hours of evaluation (regulation, for permanent hearing loss, via KY-CHILD); no-shows marked in KY-CHILD within 4 calendar days
KY.who_reports: Approved Infant Audiological Assessment and Diagnostic Centers, upon completing diagnostic testing of a child birth to 3

LA.program: Louisiana Early Hearing Detection and Intervention Program (LA EHDI), Louisiana Department of Health, Office of Public Health, Bureau of Family Health
LA.route: State online system or paper form

portal.name: HiTrack (LA EHDI web-based data management system; the 2021 form footer calls it LA EHDI-IS)

state_form.name: Follow-up Services Report (FSR), Children Birth - 3 years

LA.deadline: within 2 days of diagnosis for a child with permanent childhood hearing loss; all other results within 7 days of testing (program page; the 2021 form says within 7 days of appointment)
LA.who_reports: Audiologists (and other providers doing rescreening or diagnostic testing) for children birth to 5

MA.program: Universal Newborn Hearing Screening Program (UNHSP), Massachusetts Department of Public Health

send_to.note: Program contact; reporting route for diagnostic centers not published

MA.who_reports: DPH-approved pediatric audiological Diagnostic Centers (per the 2020 grant narrative; M.G.L. c.111 s.67F requires diagnostic exams to be offered at department-approved centers)

MD.program: Maryland Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (MD EHDI) Program / Infant Hearing Program, Office of Children and Youth with Specific Health Care Needs, Maryland Department of Health

portal.name: MD EHDI Department database (secure web-based system from OZ Systems)

MD.deadline: within 2 business days: report results, recommendations and referrals, and confirm demographics in the Department database; within 7 business days notify early intervention of confirmed or strongly suspected permanent hearing status
MD.who_reports: Any audiologist or licensed professional who performs a hearing screening or audiological diagnostic evaluation on a child under 5 who has a risk factor or did not receive or did not pass the birth screening

ME.program: Maine Newborn Hearing Program (MNHP), Maine CDC; family/professional site 'Earliest Interactions'

portal.name: Maine Audiologic Assessment Report Form (online form in SMART CHSTS, Maine's newborn screening system)

ME.who_reports: Audiologists who test children 0-3 (the online form is listed under 'Audiologists' on the program's professional resources page)

MI.program: Michigan Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) Program, MDHHS

state_form.name: Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) Program Reporting Form (instructions call it the Audiological/Medical Follow-up Service Report)

send_to.note: The state form or your own report

MI.who_reports: Health professionals, hospitals, health departments, or other facilities that give an infant a hearing test or screen, including audiologists: all results under 12 months and any diagnosed hearing loss under 3 years

MN.program: Minnesota Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (MDH-EHDI) Program, Minnesota Department of Health (Newborn Screening Program)

state_form.name: Newborn Hearing Screening Audiology Follow-up Report Form

send_to.note: Include a copy of the visit summary

MN.deadline: within one week of the scheduled visit date (MDH audiology guidelines); statute says report 'according to the Department of Health recommendations'
MN.who_reports: The professional conducting the diagnostic procedure (audiologists), for rescreens, diagnostic assessments, failed/rescheduled appointments, and all newly confirmed permanent hearing loss through age 10 years 11 months

MO.program: Missouri Newborn Hearing Screening Program, Bureau of Genetics and Healthy Childhood, Missouri Department of Health and Senior Services (DHSS)
MO.route: State online system or paper form
MO.route_note: The state's Audiologic Diagnostic Form is named in its guidelines but not posted; direct database entry is the main route

portal.name: DHSS newborn hearing database, direct entry (MOHSAIC)

state_form.name: Audiologic Diagnostic Form

MO.deadline: within 7 calendar days of completion of the diagnostic audiological assessment
MO.who_reports: The audiologist reports all diagnostic audiological assessment results (19 CSR 40-9.040(4)).

MS.program: Early Hearing Detection and Intervention Program (EHDI-MS), Mississippi State Department of Health

state_form.name: Hearing Diagnostic Report

send_to.note: The 2024 form says encrypted email
Listed in the 2019 procedures; the 2024 form names email only

MS.deadline: within 48 hours of an appointment or event requiring a report (missed appointment, refusal)
MS.who_reports: Hearing diagnostic providers, including audiologists and otolaryngologists, for every child birth to 3 evaluated after a screening referral, plus no-shows, refusals, incomplete evaluations, and later changes in hearing status

MT.program: Montana Newborn Hearing Screening and Intervention (NBHSI) Program, Children's Special Health Services, Montana DPHHS

portal.name: HiTrack (the department's designated reporting software)

MT.deadline: monthly: by the 15th day of each month for each infant assessed during the previous month
MT.who_reports: Each licensed audiologist to whom an infant is referred for audiological assessment after newborn hearing screening (ARM 37.57.415).

NC.program: North Carolina Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (NC EHDI) Program

portal.name: Hearing Link (EHDI-IS module of WCSWeb)

NC.deadline: within 5 days of the appointment (diagnostic evaluations and amplification assessments for infants under 12 months, including missed appointments)
NC.who_reports: All persons performing diagnostic auditory evaluations and amplification assessments for infants under 12 months (in practice, pediatric audiologists)

ND.program: North Dakota Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (ND EHDI), run by the ND Center for Persons with Disabilities (Minot State University) with ND HHS Newborn Screening

state_form.name: Audiology ONLINE Reporting Form (also offered as an Audiology Reporting Fax Form)

ND.deadline: none found; ND does not mandate newborn hearing screening, and hearing loss is not on the reportable conditions list

state_form.name: Audiologic Screening and Diagnostic Report Form (linked as 'Diagnostic Reporting Form')

send_to.note: Your own report is accepted if it includes the listed items

NE.deadline: as soon as possible, but no later than 5 days after the evaluation
NE.who_reports: Audiologists, for all children birth to 3 who received a diagnostic evaluation or need further testing (also outpatient screens, late identifications, behavioral and ENT evaluations).

NH.program: New Hampshire Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) Program, NH Department of Health and Human Services

portal.name: Auris (NH state database system; the rule calls it the EHDI database)

send_to.note: Secure fax, allowed by rule

NH.who_reports: Individuals conducting newborn hearing screening and diagnostic hearing evaluation; NH audiologists doing diagnostic evaluations also submit referral and follow-up information.

NJ.program: New Jersey Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (NJ EHDI) Program, Newborn Screening & Genetic Services, NJ Department of Health
NJ.route: State online system or paper form

portal.name: EHDI module of the New Jersey Immunization Information System (NJIIS)

state_form.name: Newborn Hearing Follow-Up Report

NJ.deadline: within 10 business days of the outpatient screening, rescreening or audiologic evaluation (and within 10 business days of diagnosing a permanent loss)
NJ.who_reports: Anyone performing outpatient screening, rescreening or audiologic evaluation on a child under 3; the individual who diagnoses a permanent hearing loss.

NM.program: New Mexico Newborn Hearing Screening Program / Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) Program, Children's Medical Services, NM Department of Health

state_form.name: Report of Audiological/Screening/Diagnostic Results (ROAR)

NM.who_reports: Audiologists, for diagnostic results on children from birth through age 4 (program page).

NV.program: Nevada Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) Program, Division of Public and Behavioral Health

state_form.name: Audiological Follow-Up Reporting Form (2025, fillable)

send_to.note: Or the EHDI Data Portal

NV.who_reports: Physicians, audiologists, and other persons or entities performing a newborn hearing screen, rescreen, or a diagnostic hearing assessment after a failed screen (program page).

NY.program: New York State Newborn Hearing Screening / Early Hearing Detection and Intervention Program, NYS Department of Health

portal.name: Early Hearing Detection and Intervention - Information System (EHDI-IS)

NY.who_reports: Anyone who performs an infant hearing screening and/or diagnostic audiological evaluation on a child under six months of age (10 NYCRR 69-8.7).

OH.program: Ohio Department of Health Infant Hearing Program (Ohio EHDI)

portal.name: ODH electronic UNHS Follow-up Hearing Evaluation Reporting Form (Hi*Track web submission link)

OH.deadline: within seven business days of the diagnostic hearing evaluation
OH.who_reports: Any audiologist that conducts a diagnostic hearing evaluation of a newborn, infant, or child under 36 months referred to them; required for infants who did not pass screening and for children diagnosed with hearing loss

OK.program: Oklahoma Newborn Hearing Screening Program / Oklahoma EHDI (Oklahoma State Department of Health, Screening and Special Services)

state_form.name: Diagnostic Hearing Evaluation Results

OK.who_reports: Audiologists or physicians completing follow-up hearing evaluations; the program asks for diagnostic results for children 0-3

OR.program: Oregon Health Authority Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) Program
OR.route: State online system or paper form

portal.name: Oregon EHDI Information System (EHDI-IS)

state_form.name: Diagnostic Audiology Reporting Form (Rev 03/02/2026)

send_to.note: Only when EHDI-IS is unavailable

OR.who_reports: Audiologists serving children under 36 months: required for children who referred on or missed the newborn screen, and for any child under 36 months identified as deaf or hard of hearing

PA.program: Pennsylvania Department of Health Newborn Hearing Screening and Intervention Program (Division of Newborn Screening and Genetics, DNSG)

Program contact

portal.name: KIDSNET (RIDOH integrated child health information system)

SC.program: First Sound (South Carolina Early Hearing Detection and Intervention), SC Department of Public Health

send_to.note: Program referral fax; no reporting route published

SC.who_reports: Audiologists must follow department reporting procedures (with hospitals and early interventionists), per statute

SD.program: South Dakota Department of Health Newborn Screening Program - Newborn Hearing Screening (SD EHDI)

state_form.name: Audiology Reporting Form (linked as 'Newborn Hearing Screening Provider Form'; includes Authorization to Release Information)

SD.who_reports: Providers reporting hearing screening and hearing diagnostic results (audiologists for diagnostics); rule 44:19:01:04 puts the screening duty on birth providers and midwives

TN.program: Tennessee Department of Health Newborn Screening Program - Newborn Hearing Screening

state_form.name: Texas Early Hearing Detection and Intervention Reporting Form - Diagnostic Evaluation (linked as "Texas Audiological Diagnostic Assessment Form")

TX.deadline: within five calendar days after the date of the patient encounter (entered in the TEHDI MIS)
TX.who_reports: Any healthcare provider who performs initial hearing screening, follow-up screening, diagnostic evaluations, follow-up care, or interventions.

UT.program: Utah Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) Program, DHHS Office of Children with Special Health Care Needs

send_to.note: Send your written report

UT.deadline: within seven days (to the birth institution and to the Department)
UT.who_reports: Persons who conduct any procedure necessary to complete an infant's hearing screening or audiological diagnostic assessment.

VA.program: Virginia Early Hearing Detection and Intervention Program, Virginia Department of Health

state_form.name: Hearing Screening/Diagnostic Reporting Form

VT.program: Vermont Early Hearing Detection & Intervention (VTEHDI) Program, Vermont Department of Health

portal.name: Vermont Public Health Patient Profile - hearing screening registry (Hearing application, Diagnosis tab)

VT.who_reports: Health care professionals send hearing screening and diagnostic results to VTEHDI (program page); no named duty for audiologists was found.

WA.program: Early Hearing Detection, Diagnosis and Intervention (EHDDI) Program, Washington State Department of Health
WA.route: State online system or paper form

portal.name: EHDDI Web Application

state_form.name: EHDDI Program Hearing Evaluation Form (linked as "Diagnostic Evaluation form")

WA.deadline: No number of days stated; the audiology best-practice protocol says to share findings with EHDDI 'in a timely manner' after each diagnostic assessment.
WA.who_reports: Audiologists doing diagnostic evaluations for babies who did not pass newborn screening, or who passed but have risk factors (per the program's reporting page and audiologist guide).

WI.program: Wisconsin Sound Beginnings (WSB), Wisconsin Department of Health Services Newborn Screening Program

portal.name: WE-TRAC (Wisconsin EHDI Tracking, Referral And Coordination system)

WI.who_reports: WE-TRAC users (hospitals, midwives, audiologists); audiologists enter diagnostic information there. No legal duty for audiologists found.

WV.program: West Virginia Newborn Hearing Screening Project (NHS), Office of Maternal, Child and Family Health

state_form.name: Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) Reporting Form (linked as "WV NHS Screening/Audiological Evaluation Form")

WV.who_reports: The outpatient screening or audiologic evaluation facility (the form's evaluator); the rule itself names no audiologist duty.

WY.program: Wyoming Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) Program

portal.name: Wyoming EHDI Information System (EHDI-IS)

WY.deadline: within fifteen (15) calendar days of completed evaluations
WY.who_reports: An audiologist who completes a diagnostic audiologic evaluation from a Wyoming Newborn Screening referral.
